active_location.macro_silhouette: The reinforced deck overlooking the ferrofluid sea shuddered under the immense pressure of the storm. Pylons strained visibly against the violent, dark waves crashing around them. A single, heavy iron baton served as the critical junction point between the two engineers amidst the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea.
